cards.example_en: The birds glide above the cliffs without moving their wings.
cards.example_zh: 这些鸟不扇动翅膀，在悬崖上方滑翔。
cards.explain_zh: 强调移动平稳轻盈；空中滑翔也用glide。

cards.example_en: She made a vow to visit her grandmother weekly.
cards.example_zh: 她郑重承诺每周都去看望祖母。
cards.explain_zh: 动词常用vow to do或vow that从句。

cards.example_en: Our cat remained indifferent to its expensive new toy.
cards.example_zh: 我们家的猫对昂贵的新玩具仍然毫无兴趣。
cards.explain_zh: 常用be indifferent to；这里的to是介词。

cards.example_en: Our cat remained indifferent to its expensive new toy.
cards.example_zh: 我们家的猫对昂贵的新玩具仍然毫无兴趣。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Only a remnant of the old wall still stands.
cards.example_zh: 那堵旧墙只剩下一小段还立着。
cards.explain_zh: 常用a remnant of；复数remnants强调残留的各部分。

cards.example_en: Complete eradication of these weeds will take patience.
cards.example_zh: 要彻底清除这些杂草，需要耐心。
cards.explain_zh: 强调彻底消除，常用eradication of。

cards.example_en: Our new puppy has a gentle temperament and rarely barks.
cards.example_zh: 我们新养的小狗性情温顺，很少吠叫。
cards.explain_zh: temperament指惯常性情；temper常指脾气，尤指怒气。

cards.example_en: A calm temperament helps healthcare professionals communicate effectively with patients during stressful situations in busy hospitals.
cards.example_zh: 在繁忙医院的紧张情境下，沉着的性情有助于医护人员与患者有效沟通。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The studio plans to dub the film into several languages.
cards.example_zh: 这家工作室计划将电影配音成多种语言。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式dubbed；dub A B表示“称A为B”。

cards.example_en: I baked her a cake to make amends.
cards.example_zh: 我给她烤了一个蛋糕，以此赔罪。
cards.explain_zh: 名词通常用make amends；不说an amends。

cards.example_en: I baked her a cake to make amends.
cards.example_zh: 我给她烤了一个蛋糕，以此赔罪。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Practical science lessons can ignite students' curiosity and encourage them to explore unfamiliar ideas independently.
cards.example_zh: 科学实践课能够激发学生的好奇心，鼓励他们独立探索陌生的概念。
cards.explain_zh: 可及物也可不及物；还可比喻激起兴趣或争论。

cards.example_en: Her witty reply made everyone at the table laugh.
cards.example_zh: 她机智风趣的回答逗得同桌的人都笑了。
cards.explain_zh: witty强调语言机智幽默，不泛指好笑。

cards.example_en: Her witty reply made everyone at the table laugh.
cards.example_zh: 她机智风趣的回答逗得同桌的人都笑了。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The club president used her veto to stop the purchase.
cards.example_zh: 俱乐部主席行使否决权，叫停了这次购买。
cards.explain_zh: 复数vetoes；动词过去式vetoed。

cards.example_en: The baby began to wail when her toy fell.
cards.example_zh: 玩具掉了，宝宝便放声大哭起来。
cards.explain_zh: 强调持续而尖厉的哭声，也可形容警报器长鸣。

cards.example_en: Our teacher explained adverbial phrases using simple everyday examples.
cards.example_zh: 老师用简单的日常例子讲解了状语短语。
cards.explain_zh: adverb是词类；adverbial可指单词、短语或从句的状语功能。

cards.example_en: A marble bust stood beside the museum entrance.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆入口旁立着一尊大理石半身像。
cards.explain_zh: 指雕像时是可数名词，通常只有头、肩和胸部。

cards.example_en: A marble bust stood beside the museum entrance.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆入口旁立着一尊大理石半身像。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We watched a platypus swimming quietly near the riverbank.
cards.example_zh: 我们看着一只鸭嘴兽在河岸附近静静地游泳。
cards.explain_zh: 虽会产卵，鸭嘴兽仍属于哺乳动物。

cards.example_en: Language exchange programmes allow students to converse with native speakers and develop confidence in unfamiliar social situations.
cards.example_zh: 语言交流项目让学生能够与母语使用者交谈，并培养在陌生社交场合中的自信。
cards.explain_zh: 动词重音在后；名词“相反情况”重音在前。

cards.example_en: You'll doubtless feel hungry after such a long walk.
cards.example_zh: 走了这么远，你想必饿了。
cards.explain_zh: 常表示有把握的推测，不一定是绝对确定。

cards.example_en: Improved public transport will doubtless benefit commuters, although its construction may cause temporary disruption.
cards.example_zh: 改善公共交通想必会使通勤者受益，不过施工可能造成暂时的不便。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A warm bath helped alleviate the ache in my shoulders.
cards.example_zh: 洗个热水澡帮助缓解了我的肩膀酸痛。
cards.explain_zh: 直接接痛苦或问题；表示减轻，不一定彻底消除。

cards.example_en: Expanding affordable housing could alleviate pressure on low-income families and reduce the risk of homelessness.
cards.example_zh: 增加可负担住房可以减轻低收入家庭的压力，并降低无家可归的风险。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The editor made several textual changes to my story.
cards.example_zh: 编辑对我的故事做了几处文字修改。
cards.explain_zh: textual指文本内容；textile指纺织品，勿混淆。

cards.example_en: Students should support their interpretations with textual evidence rather than rely solely on personal reactions to a novel.
cards.example_zh: 学生应以文本证据支持自己的解读，而不是仅凭对小说的个人感受。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I tidied the cushions to restore some semblance of order.
cards.example_zh: 我整理了靠垫，让屋里多少显得整齐一些。
cards.explain_zh: 常用 a semblance of，表示表面上或些许的某种状态。

cards.example_en: After severe flooding, reopening schools can help communities regain a semblance of normality while essential infrastructure is repaired.
cards.example_zh: 严重洪灾后，在必要的基础设施修复期间，重新开学可以帮助社区恢复些许正常生活的样貌。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: These dark clouds are indicative of an approaching storm.
cards.example_zh: 这些乌云预示着暴风雨即将到来。
cards.explain_zh: 常用be indicative of，表示“是……的迹象”。

cards.example_en: These dark clouds are indicative of an approaching storm.
cards.example_zh: 这些乌云预示着暴风雨即将到来。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We checked the barometer before sailing across the bay.
cards.example_zh: 我们驾船横渡海湾前查看了气压计。
cards.explain_zh: 比喻某种状况的指标时，常用a barometer of。

cards.example_en: Only the manager can authorize a refund this large.
cards.example_zh: 只有经理才能批准这么大一笔退款。
cards.explain_zh: 常用authorize sb to do；英式也写authorise。

cards.example_en: Taking an extra jacket seemed prudent before our mountain walk.
cards.example_zh: 去山里徒步前，多带一件外套似乎很稳妥。
cards.explain_zh: 强调考虑风险和后果，不只是胆小或节俭。

cards.example_en: Our heating bills treble when the weather turns cold.
cards.example_zh: 天气变冷时，我们的取暖费会增至原来的三倍。
cards.explain_zh: treble表示变为原来的三倍，即增加两倍；英式英语常用。

cards.example_en: The cunning fox waited until the dog fell asleep.
cards.example_zh: 那只狡猾的狐狸一直等到狗睡着了。
cards.explain_zh: 形容人时通常含贬义，不等于单纯的聪明。

cards.example_en: We paddled into a quiet inlet sheltered by cliffs.
cards.example_zh: 我们划进了一处被峭壁遮护的宁静小海湾。
cards.explain_zh: 地理中指小海湾；设备中指流体入口，与outlet相对。

cards.example_en: These herbs flourish on our warm, sunny kitchen windowsill.
cards.example_zh: 这些香草在我们厨房温暖、阳光充足的窗台上长得很旺。
cards.explain_zh: 表繁荣时是不及物动词，不直接接宾语。

cards.example_en: The coarse wool scratched my neck all afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 那件粗糙的羊毛衣让我的脖子整个下午都刺痒。
cards.explain_zh: 与course同音；coarse形容质地粗或言语粗俗。

cards.example_en: Coarse particles in urban air can irritate the lungs and worsen existing respiratory conditions among vulnerable residents.
cards.example_zh: 城市空气中的粗颗粒物会刺激肺部，并加重易感居民原有的呼吸系统疾病。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our free time and workload have an inverse relationship.
cards.example_zh: 我们的空闲时间与工作量呈反向关系。
cards.explain_zh: inverse relationship指一方增加时另一方减少。

cards.example_en: Our free time and workload have an inverse relationship.
cards.example_zh: 我们的空闲时间与工作量呈反向关系。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Their little shop was on the brink of closing.
cards.example_zh: 他们的小店差一点就关门了。
cards.explain_zh: on the brink of后接名词或动名词，常指危机。

cards.example_en: This cupboard is used solely for cleaning supplies.
cards.example_zh: 这个柜子只用来存放清洁用品。
cards.explain_zh: solely强调仅限某人或某事，不等于独自。

cards.example_en: My neighbours shun crowded shops and buy food online.
cards.example_zh: 我的邻居们避开拥挤的商店，在网上购买食品。
cards.explain_zh: 及物动词，直接接宾语；过去式shunned。

cards.example_en: Her nomination for the teaching award surprised everyone.
cards.example_zh: 她获教学奖提名，让大家都很惊讶。
cards.explain_zh: 提名用nomination；最终任命通常用appointment。

cards.example_en: A transparent nomination process can help ensure that leadership candidates represent the interests of the wider community.
cards.example_zh: 透明的提名程序有助于确保领导职位候选人代表更广泛群体的利益。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I'll help insofar as my busy schedule allows.
cards.example_zh: 只要繁忙的日程允许，我会尽力帮忙。
cards.explain_zh: 通常用于正式表达insofar as，后接从句。

cards.example_en: The club bans anyone who tries to molest guests.
cards.example_zh: 这家俱乐部禁止任何企图猥亵宾客的人进入。
cards.explain_zh: 现代英语多指性猥亵，勿用于普通的打扰。

cards.example_en: Researchers often subdivide survey participants into age groups to identify differences in attitudes towards public transport.
cards.example_zh: 研究人员常将调查参与者按年龄细分，以识别他们对公共交通的态度差异。
cards.explain_zh: 常用subdivide A into B，表示把A细分为B。

word.example_en: The editor made several textual changes to my story.
word.example_zh: 编辑对我的故事做了几处文字修改。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
